decisions.reason: The replacement of the clip trial already has a same-message MODIFY removing both trial-specific source-selection attributes; no additional change is required.
The same-message MODIFY already removes the trial-specific moment-selection standard made obsolete when the screening form replaced the clip trial.
Removing the trial as the current selection method does not necessarily invalidate the clean-editing standard; the existing same-message DEFER already captures that it is not currently actionable.
The same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete six-clip batch attributes, and the accompanying DEFER captures the lifecycle effect; no additional cross-Requirement change is needed.
